summary: schedule recurring jobs in a service process
use_when: run a job every few minutes, or nightly at a fixed time in a time zone
skip a slot while the last pass still goes, survive a panic, stop at shutdown
not_for: scheduling across replicas or distributed locking: it is in-process only, so two replicas both run a task unless the task claims its slot itself
cron expressions or calendars: only a fixed interval and a daily HH:MM exist
a durable job queue or retries with backoff: a slot missed while the process is down is not replayed
